use std::collections::HashMap;
use gityas_domain::models::file::{ConflictChunk, GitYasConflict};

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum DiffType {
    Equal,
    Delete,
    Insert,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct DiffOperation {
    op_type: DiffType,
    a_index: i32,
    b_index: i32,
    line: String,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq)]
enum ChunkCategory {
    AutoMerged,
    ConflictingEdit,
    OverlappingChange,
    Deletion,
    Move,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
struct ChangeRegion {
    ancestor_start: usize,
    ancestor_end: usize,
    our_start: usize,
    our_end: usize,
    their_start: usize,
    their_end: usize,
    our_changes: Vec<String>,
    their_changes: Vec<String>,
    is_conflict: bool,
    category: ChunkCategory,
}

pub struct MergeAnalyzer<'a> {
    conflict_data: &'a mut GitYasConflict,
    context_expansion_threshold: usize,
}

impl<'a> MergeAnalyzer<'a> {
    pub fn new(conflict_data: &'a mut GitYasConflict) -> Self {
        Self {
            conflict_data,
            context_expansion_threshold: 3,
        }
    }

    pub fn analyze_conflicts(&mut self) {
        let ancestor_lines: Vec<String> = self.normalize_lines(&self.conflict_data.ancestor);
        let our_lines: Vec<String> = self.normalize_lines(&self.conflict_data.ours);
        let their_lines: Vec<String> = self.normalize_lines(&self.conflict_data.theirs);

        // Compute diffs with whitespace-insensitive matching
        let our_diff: Vec<DiffOperation> = self.compute_full_diff(&ancestor_lines, &our_lines);
        let their_diff: Vec<DiffOperation> = self.compute_full_diff(&ancestor_lines, &their_lines);

        // Identify change regions with proper line tracking
        let mut regions = self.identify_change_regions(
            &our_diff,
            &their_diff,
            &ancestor_lines,
            &our_lines,
            &their_lines,
        );

        // Apply smart merge heuristics (but preserve separate chunks)
        // regions = self.apply_same_change_collapsing(regions);
        // regions = self.apply_trivial_merge_resolution(regions);
        // regions = self.collapse_deletion_gaps(regions);
        // regions = self.apply_empty_chunk_suppression(regions);
        //
        // // Context expansion should only merge VERY close chunks
        // regions = self.apply_smart_context_expansion(regions, &ancestor_lines);
        //
        // regions = self.apply_multi_chunk_collapsing(regions, &ancestor_lines);

        // Generate final conflict chunks
        let conflicts = self.generate_conflict_chunks(regions);

        // Update conflict data (don't modify the original content)
        self.conflict_data.chunks = conflicts;
        self.conflict_data.ancestor = ancestor_lines.join("\n");
    }

    fn normalize_lines(&self, content: &str) -> Vec<String> {
        content
            .lines()
            .map(|line| {
                line.replace('\r', "").replace('\t', "    ").to_string()
            })
            .collect()
    }

    fn normalize_whitespace(&self, s: &str) -> String {
        s.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
    }

    fn lines_equal_ignoring_whitespace(&self, a: &str, b: &str) -> bool {
        self.normalize_whitespace(a) == self.normalize_whitespace(b)
    }

    // Smart context expansion - only merge if there are actual shared context lines
    fn apply_smart_context_expansion(
        &self,
        mut regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>,
        ancestor_lines: &[String],
    ) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        if regions.len() <= 1 {
            return regions;
        }

        let mut merged_regions = Vec::new();
        let mut current = regions[0].clone();

        for next in regions.into_iter().skip(1) {
            // Calculate the actual gap in the ancestor
            let gap = next.ancestor_start.saturating_sub(current.ancestor_end + 1);

            // Only merge if:
            // 1. Gap is small (within threshold)
            // 2. There are actual identical context lines in between
            // 3. Both are conflicts (don't merge auto-merged with conflicts)
            let should_merge = if gap > 0 && gap <= self.context_expansion_threshold {
                // Check if the gap contains only identical lines
                let gap_lines = ancestor_lines
                    .get(current.ancestor_end + 1..next.ancestor_start)
                    .unwrap_or(&[]);

                // For now, be conservative - only merge if gap is 1 line
                gap == 1 && !gap_lines.is_empty() && current.is_conflict && next.is_conflict
            } else {
                false
            };

            if should_merge {
                current.ancestor_end = next.ancestor_end;
                current.our_end = next.our_end;
                current.their_end = next.their_end;
                current.our_changes.extend(next.our_changes);
                current.their_changes.extend(next.their_changes);
                current.is_conflict = current.is_conflict || next.is_conflict;
            } else {
                merged_regions.push(current);
                current = next;
            }
        }
        merged_regions.push(current);

        merged_regions
    }

    fn collapse_deletion_gaps(&self, mut regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        for region in &mut regions {
            if region.our_changes.is_empty() && !region.their_changes.is_empty() {
                region.category = ChunkCategory::Deletion;
            } else if !region.our_changes.is_empty() && region.their_changes.is_empty() {
                region.category = ChunkCategory::Deletion;
            }
        }
        regions
    }

    fn apply_trivial_merge_resolution(&self, mut regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        for region in &mut regions {
            if !region.is_conflict {
                continue;
            }

            let our_normalized: Vec<_> = region
                .our_changes
                .iter()
                .map(|l| self.normalize_whitespace(l))
                .collect();
            let their_normalized: Vec<_> = region
                .their_changes
                .iter()
                .map(|l| self.normalize_whitespace(l))
                .collect();

            if our_normalized == their_normalized {
                region.is_conflict = false;
                region.category = ChunkCategory::AutoMerged;
            }
        }
        regions
    }

    fn apply_same_change_collapsing(&self, mut regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        regions.retain(|region| {
            if region.our_changes == region.their_changes && !region.our_changes.is_empty() {
                return false;
            }
            true
        });
        regions
    }

    fn apply_empty_chunk_suppression(&self, mut regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        regions.retain(|region| {
            if region.our_changes.is_empty() && region.their_changes.is_empty() {
                return false;
            }
            true
        });
        regions
    }

    fn apply_multi_chunk_collapsing(
        &self,
        mut regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>,
        _ancestor_lines: &[String],
    ) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        // Only collapse if chunks are truly adjacent and overlapping
        if regions.len() <= 1 {
            return regions;
        }

        let mut merged_regions = Vec::new();
        let mut current = regions[0].clone();

        for next in regions.into_iter().skip(1) {
            // Only merge if ancestor ranges are truly overlapping
            let overlaps = current.ancestor_end >= next.ancestor_start.saturating_sub(1);

            if overlaps && current.is_conflict == next.is_conflict {
                current.ancestor_end = current.ancestor_end.max(next.ancestor_end);
                current.our_end = current.our_end.max(next.our_end);
                current.their_end = current.their_end.max(next.their_end);
                current.our_changes.extend(next.our_changes);
                current.their_changes.extend(next.their_changes);
            } else {
                merged_regions.push(current);
                current = next;
            }
        }
        merged_regions.push(current);

        merged_regions
    }

    fn identify_change_regions(
        &self,
        our_diff: &[DiffOperation],
        their_diff: &[DiffOperation],
        ancestor_lines: &[String],
        our_lines: &[String],
        their_lines: &[String],
    ) -> Vec<ChangeRegion> {
        // Build sets of which ancestor lines are modified in each side
        let our_modified: std::collections::HashSet<usize> = our_diff
            .iter()
            .filter(|op| op.op_type != DiffType::Equal)
            .map(|op| op.a_index as usize)
            .collect();

        let their_modified: std::collections::HashSet<usize> = their_diff
            .iter()
            .filter(|op| op.op_type != DiffType::Equal)
            .map(|op| op.a_index as usize)
            .collect();

        // Find all modified ancestor lines
        let mut all_modified: Vec<usize> = our_modified
            .union(&their_modified)
            .copied()
            .collect();
        all_modified.sort();

        if all_modified.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }

        // Group into chunks separated by unchanged lines
        let mut regions = Vec::new();
        let mut chunk_start = all_modified[0];
        let mut chunk_end = all_modified[0];

        for &line_idx in all_modified.iter().skip(1) {
            // If there's a gap of more than 1 line, or if the gap contains non-empty unchanged lines,
            // start a new chunk
            if line_idx > chunk_end + 1 {
                // Check if there are non-empty lines in the gap
                let has_content_in_gap = ((chunk_end + 1)..line_idx)
                    .any(|i| {
                        ancestor_lines.get(i).map(|s| !s.trim().is_empty()).unwrap_or(false)
                    });

                if has_content_in_gap || line_idx > chunk_end + 2 {
                    // Finalize current chunk
                    let (our_changes, our_range) = self.extract_changes_with_range(
                        our_diff,
                        our_lines,
                        chunk_start,
                        chunk_end,
                    );
                    let (their_changes, their_range) = self.extract_changes_with_range(
                        their_diff,
                        their_lines,
                        chunk_start,
                        chunk_end,
                    );

                    let is_conflict = !our_changes.is_empty()
                        && !their_changes.is_empty()
                        && our_changes != their_changes;

                    let category = self.categorize_change(&our_changes, &their_changes, is_conflict);

                    regions.push(ChangeRegion {
                        ancestor_start: chunk_start,
                        ancestor_end: chunk_end,
                        our_start: our_range.0,
                        our_end: our_range.1,
                        their_start: their_range.0,
                        their_end: their_range.1,
                        our_changes,
                        their_changes,
                        is_conflict,
                        category,
                    });

                    // Start new chunk
                    chunk_start = line_idx;
                    chunk_end = line_idx;
                } else {
                    // Extend current chunk
                    chunk_end = line_idx;
                }
            } else {
                // Consecutive or adjacent line
                chunk_end = line_idx;
            }
        }

        // Add the last chunk
        let (our_changes, our_range) = self.extract_changes_with_range(
            our_diff,
            our_lines,
            chunk_start,
            chunk_end,
        );
        let (their_changes, their_range) = self.extract_changes_with_range(
            their_diff,
            their_lines,
            chunk_start,
            chunk_end,
        );

        let is_conflict = !our_changes.is_empty()
            && !their_changes.is_empty()
            && our_changes != their_changes;

        let category = self.categorize_change(&our_changes, &their_changes, is_conflict);

        regions.push(ChangeRegion {
            ancestor_start: chunk_start,
            ancestor_end: chunk_end,
            our_start: our_range.0,
            our_end: our_range.1,
            their_start: their_range.0,
            their_end: their_range.1,
            our_changes,
            their_changes,
            is_conflict,
            category,
        });

        regions
    }

    fn categorize_change(
        &self,
        our_changes: &[String],
        their_changes: &[String],
        is_conflict: bool,
    ) -> ChunkCategory {
        if !is_conflict && (!our_changes.is_empty() || !their_changes.is_empty()) {
            ChunkCategory::AutoMerged
        } else if is_conflict {
            ChunkCategory::ConflictingEdit
        } else {
            ChunkCategory::AutoMerged
        }
    }

    fn build_line_mapping(&self, diff: &[DiffOperation]) -> HashMap<usize, Vec<usize>> {
        let mut map = HashMap::new();

        for op in diff {
            if op.op_type == DiffType::Insert {
                let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;
                let result_line = (op.b_index + 1) as usize;
                map.entry(anc_line).or_insert_with(Vec::new).push(result_line);
            }
        }

        map
    }

    fn group_changes_by_ancestor(&self, diff: &[DiffOperation]) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
        let mut groups = Vec::new();
        let mut current_start: Option<usize> = None;
        let mut current_end: Option<usize> = None;

        for op in diff {
            if op.op_type == DiffType::Equal {
                continue;
            }

            let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;

            match current_start {
                None => {
                    current_start = Some(anc_line);
                    current_end = Some(anc_line);
                }
                Some(_start) => {
                    // Only group truly consecutive changes (no gap at all)
                    // This ensures empty lines separate chunks
                    if anc_line == current_end.unwrap() || anc_line == current_end.unwrap() + 1 {
                        current_end = Some(anc_line.max(current_end.unwrap()));
                    } else {
                        groups.push((_start, current_end.unwrap()));
                        current_start = Some(anc_line);
                        current_end = Some(anc_line);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if let Some(start) = current_start {
            groups.push((start, current_end.unwrap()));
        }

        groups
    }

    fn extract_changes_with_range(
        &self,
        diff: &[DiffOperation],
        result_lines: &[String],
        anc_start: usize,
        anc_end: usize,
    ) -> (Vec<String>, (usize, usize)) {
        let mut changes = Vec::new();
        let mut line_numbers = Vec::new();

        for op in diff {
            let anc_line = op.a_index as usize;

            if anc_line >= anc_start && anc_line <= anc_end {
                match op.op_type {
                    DiffType::Insert => {
                        let result_line = (op.b_index) as usize;
                        if result_line < result_lines.len() {
                            changes.push(result_lines[result_line].clone());
                            line_numbers.push(result_line + 1);
                        }
                    }
                    DiffType::Delete => {
                        // Track the position where deletion occurs
                        let pos = (op.b_index + 1) as usize;
                        line_numbers.push(pos);
                    }
                    DiffType::Equal => {}
                }
            }
        }

        let range = if line_numbers.is_empty() {
            (1, 1)
        } else {
            let start = *line_numbers.iter().min().unwrap();
            let end = *line_numbers.iter().max().unwrap();
            (start, end)
        };

        (changes, range)
    }

    fn generate_conflict_chunks(&self, regions: Vec<ChangeRegion>) -> Vec<ConflictChunk> {
        regions
            .into_iter()
            .enumerate()
            .filter(|(_, region)| region.is_conflict)
            .map(|(idx, region)| ConflictChunk {
                id: format!("chunk-{}", idx),
                start_line: region.ancestor_start + 1,
                end_line: region.ancestor_end + 1,
                our_start_line: region.our_start,
                our_end_line: region.our_end,
                their_start_line: region.their_start,
                their_end_line: region.their_end,
            })
            .collect()
    }

    fn merge_change_ranges(
        &self,
        our_groups: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
        their_groups: Vec<(usize, usize)>,
    ) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
        let mut all_ranges = Vec::new();
        all_ranges.extend(our_groups);
        all_ranges.extend(their_groups);

        if all_ranges.is_empty() {
            return Vec::new();
        }

        all_ranges.sort_by_key(|r| r.0);

        let mut merged = Vec::new();
        let mut current = all_ranges[0];

        for range in all_ranges.iter().skip(1) {
            // Only merge if ranges actually overlap or are immediately consecutive
            // Don't merge ranges separated by gaps (empty lines)
            if range.0 <= current.1 + 1 && range.0 > 0 && current.1 + 1 >= range.0 {
                current.1 = current.1.max(range.1);
            } else {
                merged.push(current);
                current = *range;
            }
        }
        merged.push(current);

        merged
    }

    fn compute_full_diff(&self, a: &[String], b: &[String]) -> Vec<DiffOperation> {
        let trace = self.compute_myers_diff(a, b);
        self.trace_to_diff(&trace, a, b)
    }

    fn compute_myers_diff(&self, a: &[String], b: &[String]) -> Vec<HashMap<i32, i32>> {
        let n = a.len() as i32;
        let m = b.len() as i32;
        let max = n + m;
        let mut v = HashMap::new();
        let mut trace = Vec::new();

        v.insert(1, 0);

        for d in 0..=max {
            let mut new_v = v.clone();
            for k in (-d..=d).step_by(2) {
                let x = if k == -d
                    || (k != d && v.get(&(k - 1)).unwrap_or(&0) < v.get(&(k + 1)).unwrap_or(&0))
                {
                    *v.get(&(k + 1)).unwrap_or(&0)
                } else {
                    v.get(&(k - 1)).unwrap_or(&0) + 1
                };

                let mut y = x - k;
                let mut x_mut = x;

                // Use exact comparison for now - whitespace-insensitive can be too aggressive
                while x_mut < n && y < m && a[x_mut as usize] == b[y as usize] {
                    x_mut += 1;
                    y += 1;
                }

                new_v.insert(k, x_mut);

                if x_mut >= n && y >= m {
                    trace.push(new_v);
                    return trace;
                }
            }

            trace.push(new_v.clone());
            v = new_v;
        }

        trace
    }

    fn trace_to_diff(
        &self,
        trace: &[HashMap<i32, i32>],
        a: &[String],
        b: &[String],
    ) -> Vec<DiffOperation> {
        let mut x = a.len() as i32;
        let mut y = b.len() as i32;
        let mut diffs = Vec::new();

        for d in (0..trace.len()).rev() {
            let v = &trace[d];
            let k = x - y;

            let prev_k = if k == -(d as i32)
                || (k != d as i32 && v.get(&(k - 1)).unwrap_or(&0) < v.get(&(k + 1)).unwrap_or(&0))
            {
                k + 1
            } else {
                k - 1
            };

            let prev_x = *v.get(&prev_k).unwrap_or(&0);
            let prev_y = prev_x - prev_k;

            while x > prev_x && y > prev_y {
                diffs.push(DiffOperation {
                    op_type: DiffType::Equal,
                    a_index: x - 1,
                    b_index: y - 1,
                    line: a[(x - 1) as usize].clone(),
                });
                x -= 1;
                y -= 1;
            }

            if d > 0 {
                if x > prev_x {
                    diffs.push(DiffOperation {
                        op_type: DiffType::Delete,
                        a_index: x - 1,
                        b_index: y - 1,
                        line: a[(x - 1) as usize].clone(),
                    });
                    x -= 1;
                } else {
                    diffs.push(DiffOperation {
                        op_type: DiffType::Insert,
                        a_index: x - 1,
                        b_index: y - 1,
                        line: b[(y - 1) as usize].clone(),
                    });
                    y -= 1;
                }
            }
        }

        diffs.reverse();
        diffs
    }
}
